set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
targets=[(-1003847210571,273),(-1002373696859,1724),(-1002373696859,4291),(-1003770334893,18)]
for chat,topic in targets:
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py','--chat-id',str(chat),'--topic-id',str(topic)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
 if p.returncode:
  print('LEGACY_PIN_LOOKUP_FAILED',chat,topic)
  continue
 res=[json.loads(x.split('=',1)[1]) for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.startswith('USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=')]
 if len(res)!=1 or len(res[0].get('rows',[]))!=1:
  print('LEGACY_PIN_INCONCLUSIVE',chat,topic);continue
 row=res[0]['rows'][0]
 print('LEGACY_PIN_ROLE',chat,topic,json.dumps(row.get('legacy_pin'),sort_keys=True))
PY
echo LEGACY_PIN_SENDER_AUDIT_FINISHED
